chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Do not abandon trade, lest you become insignificant. Engage in trade—may Allah bless you.

key_terms.بَارَكَ: He blessed or may He bless
key_terms.فَتَهُونُوا: then you become insignificant or humbled

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about abandoning trade?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs believers not to abandon trade and earning a livelihood. The hadith encourages engagement in commerce and portrays productive economic activity as a means of dignity and Divine blessing.
